items.name: Kamloops
items.text: No Shooting or Hunting Area and No Shooting Area: a band along the South Thompson River from Kamloops east to the Pritchard Bridge.

items.name: Sun Peaks
items.text: No hunting or shooting within 400 m (437 yd) of any ski lift, run, facility or development of Sun Peaks Resort.
items.src: BC Hunting and Trapping Regulations Synopsis 2026 to 2028, page 35

items.text: No Shooting or Hunting Area of about 6,934 hectares around Moul Creek and the south slopes of Trophy Mountain. Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3 s. 46 (not printed in the synopsis).
items.src: Closed Areas Regulation (BC Wildlife Act)
